Creates a ship in a scoped country

	type = ship_type:key			# Type of ship to create  
	fleet = scope:fleet				# Fleet to assign the created ship to  
	save_scope_as = scope_name		# If specified, saves the created ship in the given scope name

## exile_character
Exile a character to the exile pool  
exile_character = bool (yes - exile [by default], no - don't do anything)  
exile_character = {  
	exile_pool = regional_exile_pool_key (optional - exile to a Regional Exile Pool instead of the global exile pool)  
	months/years = int (optional - the character automatically returns to their home country after this duration; requires exile_pool)  
	value = bool (yes - exile [by default], no - don't do anything)  
}
**Supported Scopes**: character
